china-1931-2:p0153_5.rationale: Counts of suicides and deaths from accidents or violence in 1930, split Chinese and non-Chinese. Suicide is named in the title, but the figure is combined with accidental and violent deaths.
review_questions: Vocabulary lacks a tag for combined accident/violence deaths; the suicide tag is applied because suicide is part of the printed category.
